channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Eddie House | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Eddie House from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Paul Pierce, Eddie House, Leon Powe
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“Was I the only 2008 member missing from the duck boat? No, I wasn’t. (Eddie) House, my guy, he was there. Leon Powe, great friend of mine as well, he was there. Scal was there and Paul (Pierce) was there. There was still 11 other guys missing. And to be honest with you, if I would’ve gotten an invite, which I didn’t — I didn’t know we was supposed to — but anyways, nine times out of 10, I would’ve turned it down.… That’s not our moment. That’s 2024′s moment. Let those guys have their moment.”

Kendrick Perkins on Paul Pierce, Eddie House, Leon Powe, Jun 25, 2024. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tony Allen, Eddie House, Glen Davis, Leon Powe
item.description:
Rivers said on Sunday at practice.

“There’s a lot of teams that go through that. We won a title doing that one year. We literally did. Big Baby (Glen Davis) or Leon Powe. Tony Allen or Eddie House. They didn’t play every night, but I thought to our team, it was very healthy because it was a competition.”

Doc Rivers on Tony Allen, Eddie House, Glen Davis, Leon Powe, Dec 18, 2022. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Rajon Rondo on if he's going to mentor Lonzo Ball:

“Yeah that's obviously. My rookie year my guys were Sam Cassell, Stephon Marbury, and Eddie House. I didn't look at this guys as competition.”

Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @bgarciaivsports.
